entries.note: Heading the tracking page script gives the booking entry, which says the number was booked at a centre on a date; the parcel is handed in at the counter.
A scan sending the parcel on to another centre. Older scans give this sentence where the first centre goes; newer ones name both centres and get the same sentence from the adapter.
A scan receiving the parcel at a centre. Newer scans also name the centre it came from, which the adapter adds as From [centre].
Heading the tracking page script gives delivery-run entries whose reason mentions delivery. The adapter gives it to a run sheet without an outcome.
A delivery run sheet's outcome, at the run sheet's clock, which the booking's status date repeats. Also seen in capitals.
The booking's status once delivered, with the day as d/m/yyyy; its reason reads DELIVERED. The page heads the parcel with it.
